items.name: Avy
items.description: Today’s lifesavers urgently need a middle way between cars and helicopters. Avy’s fully electric drone response network offers them an affordable, reliable and integrated solution for their missions, minus the emissions.

items.name: Flapper Drones
items.description: Immerse yourself in the universe of bioinspired flight. We develop drones for recreational and entertainment purposes.

items.name: HiView
items.description: HiView deploys a range of platforms on which various sensors (both in the visible and non-visible parts of the spectrum) can be mounted. Raw data is converted to information using various state-of-the-art software packages. Information is transferred to knowledge by our highly qualified scientific staff.

items.name: Mapture.ai
items.description: Over the past years, we have seen drones being used more and more for various applications. However, we believe that this is just the tip of the iceberg. The true potential of drones will be unleashed when they no longer require a drone-pilot. Drones are perfectly able to fly by themselves. Our drone-in-a-box solution offers completely automated data acquisition without the need for a drone-pilot.

items.name: Pats
items.description: Our bio-inspired solution proactively controls harmful insect populations. The bat-like drones work autonomously and keep plagues in check. By selectively eliminating harmful insects the ecological balance in a greenhouse ecosystem is sustained.
